title: TFEC 1-2019, Standard for Design of Timber Frame Structures
use: Sections 2–3: member design, seasoning, notches and connections. Design must address net sections and actual force transfer; the carved solids are not a design calculation.

title: TFEC 2-2018, Code of Standard Practice
use: Sections 4–6: joint detailing, erection shoring/bracing and tolerances. An unspecified tolerance is not assumed to be zero. Fabrication tolerances are not a license to leave bearing faces unsupported.

title: TFEC Technical Bulletin 2011-03, Rules of Timber Joinery Design
use: Bearing load transfer, preservation of member strength, shrinkage-compatible geometry and explicit consideration of failure modes.

title: USDA Forest Products Laboratory, Wood Handbook (2021), Chapter 4
use: Moisture-dependent, directional dimensional change and variability between pieces. A universal clearance cannot be inferred from a digital fit.

title: American Wood Council, 2024 NDS and NDS Supplement
use: Use the governing adopted design standard and matching design values. Species, grade, section and applicable adjustment factors remain unconfirmed; the listed edition is not a determination of local code.

title: ASCE, About the Hazard Tool
use: Location-specific hazard parameters require project inputs and the applicable standard. No site hazard values were assumed for this review.
